# Tarsal tunnel syndrome

*Categories: Clinical knowledge > Surgery > Trauma and orthopedic surgery > Lower extremity > Tarsal tunnel syndrome*

[Original Article Link](/library/5t0iV3)

---

## Summary

<u>Tarsal tunnel</u> syndrome is a <u>compression neuropathy</u> of the <u>posterior</u> <u>tibial nerve</u> within the <u>tarsal tunnel</u>. Trauma is the most common cause, but other causes include inflammatory disease, bony <u>malformations</u>, and tumors. Manifestations include <u>neuropathic pain</u>, <u>paresthesia</u>, and numbness (which worsen with activity) in the posteromedial ankle, heel, and toes. Muscle <u>atrophy</u> may be present in severe cases. On examination, symptoms may be reproducible on provocative tests (e.g., <u>tinel sign</u>, <u>dorsiflexion</u>-<u>eversion</u> test). Diagnostics include imaging and <u>electrodiagnostic tests</u> to confirm the diagnosis and rule out <u>differential diagnoses of chronic heel pain</u>. <u>Tarsal tunnel</u> syndrome is generally <u>managed conservatively</u>, with <u>surgery</u> reserved for refractory cases.

---

## Definitions

Neuropathy caused by compression of the <u>posterior</u> <u>tibial nerve</u> or its branches within the <u>tarsal tunnel</u> [[1]](/library/fVdkFK0)[[2]](/library/PF1WRi0)




![Tarsal tunnel (malleolar canal) with flexor retinaculum of the foot](media/bqqa8nxwdyt6jlm59r3di67p.jpg)

Tarsal tunnel (malleolar canal) with flexor retinaculum of the foot

---

## Etiology

* Trauma (most common): <u>fracture</u> or <u>sprain</u> of the ankle (<u>talus</u>, <u>calcaneus</u>, <u>medial malleolus</u>)

* <u>Rheumatoid arthritis</u>

* <u>Bone spurs</u>

* Tumors

* Cysts

* Nerve ganglions

* Biomechanical abnormalities of the foot (e.g., <u>pes planus</u>)

* <u>Idiopathic</u>

---

## Clinical features

* Sensory symptoms [[1]](/library/fVdkFK0)[[2]](/library/PF1WRi0)

* Develop in areas innervated by the <u>tibial nerve</u> (i.e., posteromedial ankle, heel, <u>medial</u> longitudinal arch, and toes)

* <u>Neuropathic pain</u>

* <u>Paresthesia</u>

* Numbness

* Worsen with activity (e.g., walking, running) and standing

* Better with rest and elevation

* Muscle <u>atrophy</u>: in severe cases [[1]](/library/fVdkFK0)[[2]](/library/PF1WRi0)

---

## Diagnosis

* Clinical evaluation: <u>pain</u> or <u>paresthesia</u> elicited on provocative tests [[1]](/library/fVdkFK0)[[2]](/library/PF1WRi0)

* <u>Tinel sign</u>: percussion over the <u>tibial nerve</u> <u>posterior</u> to the <u>medial malleolus</u>

* <u>Dorsiflexion</u> with <u>eversion of the foot</u>

* <u>Plantar flexion</u> with <u>inversion of the foot</u>

* <u>Confirmatory testing</u>: Consider specialist referral (e.g., <u>neurology</u>, <u>podiatry</u>).[[1]](/library/fVdkFK0)[[2]](/library/PF1WRi0)[[3]](/library/Q61uk30)

* <u>X-ray</u> foot (consider <u>weight-bearing</u> <u>x-rays</u>) should be obtained in all patients to:

* Evaluate for an underlying bony etiology

* Rule out common <u>differential diagnoses of chronic heel pain</u>

* <u>Ultrasound</u> foot or <u>MRI</u> foot without IV contrast: to confirm compression of the <u>posterior</u> <u>tibial nerve</u> or its branches   [[3]](/library/Q61uk30)

* <u>Electrodiagnostic studies</u> (e.g., <u>electromyography</u>, <u>nerve conduction studies</u>): Consider in case of diagnostic uncertainty.  [[1]](/library/fVdkFK0)

---

## Treatment

<u>Tarsal tunnel</u> syndrome is generally <u>managed conservatively</u>, with <u>surgery</u> reserved for refractory cases. For athletes, see “<u>Compression neuropathies in sport</u>.”




* <u>Conservative treatment</u>: Options include [[1]](/library/fVdkFK0)

* Nonpharmacological treatment, e.g., rest, orthotic shoes, modification of daily activities, <u>physical therapy</u>

* Pharmacological treatment, e.g.:

* <u>NSAIDs</u> (oral or topical)

* <u>Adjuvant analgesia</u> (i.e., <u>tricyclic antidepressant</u> and <u>antiepileptics</u>)

* <u>Ultrasound</u>-guided <u>corticosteroid</u> injection

* Surgical treatment : Consider for individuals with refractory symptoms. [[1]](/library/fVdkFK0)[[2]](/library/PF1WRi0)
